text:
jon: FYI: RC freeze in ~48h. We need release/1.12 branch created by EOD tomorrow. If you have cherry-pick requests, drop them here and label `backport: candidate`. We'll only accept bugfixes, security, and docs. Can maintainers approve afterwards? :shipit:

maria: Planning to cut the branch at 09:30 PT tomorrow. Heads-up to infra folks: please hold merges to main after 09:00 PT for any risky changes.

sam: Quick question — are non-critical perf improvements allowed as backports? They touch runtime.

jon: No — only low-risk bugfixes. Perf changes need bench + approval from eng-runtime.

lee: I'll post a short checklist in the morning: branch creation command + backport instructions. Also please include changelog entries linked to PRs.

maria: For backports, use this pattern: `git checkout -b backport/1.12-<pr> && git cherry-pick -x <commit>`. PR title: `backport(1.12): <short desc> (#<orig-pr>)`.

sam: Thanks — will add `backport:` label to the PRs I open. Also pinging @infra for the cutover window.

ci-bot: CI: branch protection check OK for release/1.12 when created. 3/3 checks passed.

ara: We can reserve capacity for the cut at 09:30 PT. Recommend a 30-min window for smoke tests. I'll set a deploy block from 09:00–10:00 PT.

maria: :thumbsup: noted. Anyone with urgent cherry-picks please paste commits and tests. We'll triage in the morning.

sam: I have one candidate: commit `abc123` needs backport, tests added. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2345

jon: Added to the candidate list. If you don't see it by EOD please nudge me.

lee: Checklist link: https://go/release-checklist (internal) — includes rollback steps.

jon: :eyes: let's keep this thread as the canonical place for backport requests. I'll create release/1.12 with tags once branch exists.
